title: Week 10 Applied Lab: Hugging Face Transformer Pipeline Architecture
html:
Week 10 Applied Lab: Hugging Face Transformer Pipeline Architecture

Assignment Objective: Explore the Hugging Face Transformers ecosystem by architecting a multi-modal customer support chatbot pipeline integrating speech recognition, text classification, and autoregressive generation.

Laboratory Instructions & Tasks

Step 1: Model Selection & Taxonomy Mapping

Survey the Hugging Face Model Hub to identify appropriate models for a three-tier pipeline: (1) Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR, e.g., Whisper), (2) Intent Classification (Encoder-only, e.g., DistilBERT), and (3) Response Generation (Decoder-only, e.g., Llama/Mistral/Qwen).

Step 2: Pipeline Implementation in Python

Write a Python script or Google Colab notebook utilizing `transformers.pipeline` to instantiate the components. Implement tokenization, inference passing, and output formatting.

Step 3: Pipeline Latency & Attention Analysis

Benchmark the inference time of each component across 5 sample customer queries. Document how self-attention mechanisms handle varying input sequence lengths.

Step 4: Notebook Submission

Submit your commented `.ipynb` notebook (or Python script + execution log PDF) demonstrating end-to-end execution with test outputs, architectural rationale, and compute trade-off analysis.

Submission Guidelines

  • Submission Types: Online text entry or file upload.
  • Allowed File Extensions: ipynb,pdf,py
  • Due Date: Sunday at 11:59 PM (Midnight) Mountain Time.
  • Total Points: 50.0 pts
